additional_info.subject: Ticket Request – Sicharge D MP/R6 170002081 / Touchscreen Not Working
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We request the opening of a support ticket regarding an issue reported by the client more than one week ago on the Sicharge D charger, serial number MP/R6 170002081.
The touchscreen is not working.
Several restart attempts have been performed without success.
This issue is impacting site operations. The site is configured for RFID badge usage, and the malfunction prevents drivers from charging properly.
Please take this request into account as soon as possible.
We remain available for any additional information.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure
.
